title: Problem
问题
html: AMEX asks how to give mobile GUI agents a training and evaluation surface that contains more than action coordinates. The primary sources are the ACL Anthology Findings 2025 paper, the arXiv record, the project page, the codebase, and the Hugging Face dataset. The collection target is Android GUI-control on popular third-party apps, not API-tool use or a live reinforcement-learning environment. A data item may include a screenshot, interactive-element boxes, screen and element function descriptions, a natural-language instruction, and a stepwise GUI-action chain. Its atlas value is that success can be studied through visible GUI grounding and action-chain supervision instead of only final task completion.

AMEX 解决的问题是：移动 GUI 智能体不能只靠坐标动作学习，还需要可审计的界面元素、功能语义和分步动作链。主要来源是 ACL Anthology 的 Findings 2025 正式条目、arXiv、项目页、GitHub 和 Hugging Face 数据卡。它收的是 Android 第三方应用上的 GUI 控制数据，不是 API 调用环境，也不是在线 RL 环境。一个样本可包含截图、交互元素框、屏幕/元素功能描述、自然语言指令和逐步 GUI 动作链；对 atlas 的价值在于把移动端轨迹拆成可复用的视觉 grounding 与过程监督对象。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html: The contribution is a multi-level Android GUI dataset for generalist mobile agents. AMEX changes the usual AITW-style trajectory object by adding three annotation levels: interactive element grounding, screen and element functionality descriptions, and complex instructions with stepwise GUI-action chains averaging about 13 steps. The feedback contract is mixed: human filtering and checking validate boxes and descriptions, while released evaluation tools and downstream action/grounding tasks provide model-comparison scores. The closest comparisons are AITW, AitZ, MoTIF, UGIF, and PixelHelp; AMEX is a direction signal for richer mobile trajectory data, not a proof that an agent can safely execute arbitrary real-app tasks.

核心贡献是一套多层 Android GUI 数据集，用来训练和评测通用移动端 GUI 智能体。它相对 AITW 式轨迹的变化是增加三层对象：交互元素 grounding、屏幕和元素功能描述、以及平均约 13 步的复杂指令与动作链。反馈契约是混合的：元素框和描述经人工过滤/检查，模型比较依赖公开评测工具和 grounding/action 任务分数。最近对比对象是 AITW、AitZ、MoTIF、UGIF 和 PixelHelp；它的方向信号是“更细粒度的移动轨迹语义”，不是“真实应用自动执行已经安全可靠”。

title: Method
方法
html: 1. Inputs: Android screenshots and XML-like layout signals from emulator collection, target apps, app descriptions when available, and human-written or generated task instructions. 2. Pipeline: collect raw GUI operations from human annotators and an autonomous tool; parse candidate interactive boxes; manually filter visible clickable and scrollable elements; use GPT-4o with marked screenshots and app context to draft screen and element functionality descriptions; manually check descriptions; record or construct stepwise instruction-action chains. 3. Outputs: screenshot records, element boxes and functions, screen descriptions, instructions, action chains, sample data on Hugging Face, a codebase for conversion, finetuning, and inference, and a baseline SPHINX Agent recipe. 4. Feedback: human annotation checks validate annotation quality, while benchmark evaluation tools score grounding or action behavior. Reuse requires pinning the ACL/arXiv version, HF revision, code commit, split files, evaluator scripts, emulator/device assumptions, and whether L1/L2/L3 annotation levels are being used.

1. 输入：Android 截图、模拟器采集得到的布局信号、目标应用、可用的应用描述，以及人工或生成的任务指令。2. 流程：由人工标注者和自动工具采集原始 GUI 操作；解析候选交互元素框；人工过滤可见的点击/滚动元素；用 GPT-4o 结合标记截图和应用上下文生成屏幕与元素功能描述；再由人工检查；同时记录或构造逐步指令-动作链。3. 输出：截图记录、元素框和功能、屏幕描述、指令、动作链、HF 样例/完整数据、转换与微调代码、SPHINX Agent baseline。4. 反馈：人工检查保证标注质量，公开评测脚本给 grounding 或 action 行为打分。复用前要固定 ACL/arXiv 版本、HF revision、代码 commit、split、评测脚本、模拟器/设备假设，以及实际使用的是 L1/L2/L3 哪些层级。

title: Evidence
证据
html: The official sources report over 104K high-resolution screenshots from popular Android applications, about 711K element-wise functionality annotations, roughly 3K unique instructions, and stepwise action chains with an average length near 13. The project page describes human filtering of GUI boxes and human checking of GPT-generated descriptions; the HF dataset card exposes sample folders for instruction annotations, element annotations, and screenshots, with the full dataset distributed as large split zip files. These are dataset-release and annotation-process signals, not row-level guarantees for every action chain. Evidence is bounded by the public artifact revision, the availability of split files, evaluator code, and the fact that downstream metrics may depend on action-space conversions.

官方来源报告 AMEX 含 104K+ 高分辨率截图、约 711K 元素级功能标注、约 3K 唯一指令，以及平均接近 13 步的动作链。项目页说明元素框经过人工过滤，GPT 生成的屏幕/元素描述经过人工检查；HF 数据卡能看到 instruction annotation、element annotation 和 screenshot 的样例目录，完整数据以大体积分片 zip 发布。这些证据说明数据发布和标注流程存在，但不等于每条动作链都有独立可复验保证。证据边界取决于公开 artifact revision、split、评测代码可用性，以及不同 benchmark 的动作空间转换。

title: Novelty
新意
html: The prior baseline is mobile GUI data that mainly records screenshots, UI features, and actions, with weaker element-function semantics or less third-party app coverage. AMEX changes the data object by aligning visible interactive boxes, functionality descriptions, and long instruction-action chains on the same Android screens. The direction signal is a reusable schema for training/evaluating agents that need to reason over screen layout and element affordances. What is not new: Android emulators, screenshot trajectories, human demonstrations, GPT-assisted annotation, and action matching are established components. Before reuse, inspect license, HF split integrity, zip reconstruction, author/version mismatch across official pages, app distribution, evaluator assumptions, and contamination risk from public screenshots.

既有基线多是截图、UI 特征和动作轨迹，元素功能语义较弱，或第三方应用覆盖不足。AMEX 的新意在于把可见交互元素框、功能描述、长指令-动作链对齐到同一批 Android 截图上，形成更适合 GUI agent 的数据对象。它的方向信号是可复用的数据 schema：不仅看坐标，还看布局、功能和动作意图。不是新的部分包括 Android 模拟器、截图轨迹、人工演示、GPT 辅助标注和 action matching。复用前要查 license、HF split/zip 完整性、官方页面之间的作者/版本差异、应用分布、评测脚本假设和公开截图带来的污染风险。

title: Limitations
局限
html: Correctness is relative to the released annotations and evaluators, not to live task success in current mobile apps. GPT-generated functionality descriptions may be checked only under the authors' protocol and can still encode visual or semantic mistakes. Android apps, emulator versions, account states, screen resolutions, and UI content drift over time. The HF dataset viewer cannot parse the split names for the default config, so consumers should verify downloaded files and hashes themselves. Public screenshots and instructions can contaminate future model training, and artifact licenses must be checked separately for code, data, model checkpoints, and ACL paper materials.

正确性只相对于已发布标注和评测脚本成立，不等于当前真实手机应用上的任务成功。GPT 生成的功能描述即使经过作者流程检查，仍可能有视觉或语义错误。Android 应用、模拟器版本、账号状态、分辨率和动态内容都会漂移。HF 数据集页面无法为 default config 解析 split names，下载者需要自行核验文件和哈希。公开截图和指令也可能进入后续模型训练造成污染；代码、数据、模型 checkpoint 和 ACL 论文材料的 license 要分别查。

title: Usefulness
用途
html: AMEX is useful as a recipe for multi-layer mobile GUI supervision and as a benchmark surface for grounding, screen understanding, and action-chain modeling. A reusable record should preserve app identity, screenshot id, element boxes, element type or affordance, screen description, element functionality, instruction, step index, action, action target, split, annotator/GPT provenance where available, and evaluator version. For atlas work, it is a strong example of environment-agent trajectory data with human/GPT annotation contracts, but downstream comparisons should keep L1/L2/L3 tasks separate.

AMEX 可作为多层移动 GUI 监督的数据配方，也可作为 grounding、屏幕理解和动作链建模的评测面。复用记录应保留 app 身份、截图 id、元素框、元素类型或 affordance、屏幕描述、元素功能、指令、step id、动作、动作目标、split、可用的人工/GPT provenance 和评测器版本。对 atlas 来说，它是环境-智能体轨迹数据的强例子，但比较时要把 L1/L2/L3 任务分开，不能把元素 grounding 分数当成完整任务成功率。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html: Read the formal ACL record for citation metadata, then the project page for the collection pipeline, then the HF card and codebase for reuse details. Keep three claims separate: annotation scale, benchmark performance, and live mobile-agent reliability. The strongest audit question is whether a downstream experiment uses the same action space and annotation level as AMEX, because L1/L2 element grounding evidence does not automatically validate L3 instruction-chain execution.
阅读顺序建议先看 ACL Anthology 正式元数据，再看项目页的数据流程，最后看 HF 数据卡和代码仓库。要分清三个结论：标注规模、benchmark 表现、真实移动端智能体可靠性。最重要的审计问题是下游实验是否使用了同一动作空间和同一标注层级；L1/L2 的元素 grounding 证据不能自动证明 L3 指令链执行成功。
